faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the BEML Officer (Gr II), Safety recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the BEML Officer (Gr II), Safety posts is 09 September 2026. Ensure you complete the application process before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Officer (Gr II), Safety post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Diploma in Industrial Safety from a recognized institute and a First Class Degree in Engineering to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for the Officer (Gr II), Safety role?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Officer (Gr II), Safety position is 29 years. Age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Officer (Gr II), Safety post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies announced for the Officer (Gr II), Safety position in the BEML recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Officer (Gr II), Safety position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Officer (Gr II), Safety post will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 40,000 to Rs. 1,40,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC category candidates is Rs. 500/-. SC/ST candidates are exempted from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes an Assessment, followed by a Pre-employment Medical Examination and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. In which city will the selected candidates be posted?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will be posted in Bangalore, Karnataka.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any relaxation in the age limit for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an age relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST candidates, 3 years for OBC-NCL, and an additional 10 years for PwD candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification PDF and the online application link in the "Important Links" section of this article.
